msg: VGS AT THE DIE, matched dice plus the architecture's +/-0.15 nH gate-loop mismatch. architecture SIM-3 window. The EPC2019's own abs max is +6.0 V (parts/C2836675.json) and the LMG1020's output-pin rating is 5.75 V (parts/C6423790.json); 5.75 is the tighter of the two and is what SIM-3 specifies.
EPC2019 VGS_min absolute maximum, parts/C2836675.json. This is the rail the whole 4R7-vs-6R8 argument (route-notes.md s14) was fought over.

SPURIOUS RE-TURN-ON. Highest VGS in the settled part of the off half-cycle, against VGSth_min 0.8 V (typ 1.4 V), parts/C2836675.json. This is where common-source injection (0.157 nH x di/dt) and Miller feed-through (Crss 0.7 pF x dV/dt) land - the mechanism review-board.md W1 escalated to P8.
LMG1020 OUTH pin absolute maximum, parts/C6423790.json. TI's >= 2 ohm series-resistor rule exists to hold this; 4R7 per leg gives 2.35 ohm per driver pin.

architecture/decisions.md SIM-3: peak drain-current sharing between the two dice with a +/-0.15 nH gate-loop mismatch. This gates the D1 LAYOUT requirement (mirrored gate legs); the as-routed legs are exact copper mirrors, so the seeded mismatch is 1.5x the design tolerance.
RMS sharing on the same matched-dice case - the number that turns into a Tj difference between the two dice.

PEAK sharing with DATASHEET-CORNER dice (Q1 typ vs Q2 at Rds 90 mohm hot AND Coss 150 pF / Qoss 23 nC). decisions.md D1 permits paralleling on the argument that 'Class E is soft-switched: at turn-on the drain is at ~0 V so there is no discharge spike to hog'. 40 percent is calibrated to separate the two regimes measured here: 10.6 percent when ZVS holds, 62 percent when it does not. A failure here is a ZVS failure, not a layout failure.

RMS sharing at the device corner. The Rds ratio alone (90/65 mohm) puts the floor near 16 percent. Pessimistic by construction: SPICE has no self-heating, so the positive Rds tempco D1 relies on to equalise static sharing cannot act.
VGS at the die with corner dice, against the EPC2019's +6.0 V absolute maximum.

The same measurement against the tighter architecture SIM-3 / LMG1020 pin limit of 5.75 V. Corner dice push it close: the extra half-volt is common-source injection into the die that hogs the turn-on discharge.
EPC2019 VGS_min at the device corner.
architecture SIM-3: residual |VGS| 4 ns after the turn-off command, as a percentage of the 5 V drive. Advisory - it validates the loop damping rather than a rating.
The 6R8 turn-off variant P7 fitted and the P8 fix pass reverted. Same rail, gated the same way; the 4R7-vs-6R8 comparison itself is in reports/sim-notes.md.
Spurious-turn-on margin on the 6R8 variant, in the same window as vgs_off_max_v so the two are directly comparable.
